Subject: SOC 2 onboarding — can we get an intake call next week?

Hi Connor / Marissa,

We're kicking off our SOC 2 review for the project with Redwood and want to get an intake call scheduled next week to align on scope, deliverables, and timelines. High level: CloudBridge will need the usual evidence mapping, data flow diagram, and a short list of point people on your side.

Proposed times (PDT):
- Tue Jun 1, 10:00–10:30
- Tue Jun 1, 14:00–14:30
- Wed Jun 2, 09:00–09:30

If none of those work we can propose alternate slots. Also, please send over any template you prefer for evidence items so we can pre-populate.

Thanks,
Alex

alex.kim@cloudbridge.com

Subject: Re: SOC 2 onboarding — can we get an intake call next week?

Hi Alex — thanks for the note. Tue Jun 1 at 14:00 PDT works for us; we'll block 30 minutes. Agenda proposal:
1) Confirm scope and systems in-scope (data stores, integrations)
2) Evidence matrix & owners (we'll share our mapping template)
3) Data flow diagram / network access needs
4) Timeline and next steps (audit windows, SLAs for evidence)

I've attached our intake template and a working evidence mapping we typically send to customers so you can see the columns we use. Laura (Security PM) will own the evidence collection and follow-ups; Marissa (CS) will coordinate scheduling and access.

Proposed attendees: Alex, Priya (your compliance lead), Connor (solutions), Laura (security), Marissa (CS). Please confirm.

Meeting link: https://meet.google.com/xyz-abcq-123

Attachments:
- redwood_intake_template.xlsx (attachment)
- RBW_SOC2_evidence_mapping.xlsx (attachment)

Thanks — Connor
